498A/302/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And  In Re : Keshab Purkait  ....... petitioner  Mr. Sabyasachi Chatterjee  Mr. Omar Faruk Gazi  Mr. A. Mukherjee  .....for the petitioner  Mr. Parthapratim Das  Mr. A.S.Chatterjee  .....for the State

1.
Petitioner is in custody for more than 5 years.
2. He submits there is inordinate delay in trial.
He prays for bail.
3. Learned lawyer for the State submits report.
He contends that the victim lady was assaulted on the head and died.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is the husband of the victim lady.
She was murdered at her matrimonial home.
Though the allegations are serious, the petitioner is in custody for more than 5 years.
Only 5 out of 18 witnesses have been examined.
There is little possibility of trial concluding in near future.
5. Under such circumstances, we are inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

6. Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kakdwip, South 24 Parganas.
